headline: Public hearings on 692 Millbury Street billboard, 167-177 Southwest Cutoff gas station, and 195 Mill Street multi-family dwellings.
summary: Eight public hearings are scheduled on zoning requests, including townhouses on Kiara Drive and Crown Street and a duplex on Dana Avenue. Other business covers communications, board elections, and training opportunities.
items: 692 Millbury Street billboard: convert south face to digital display (ZB-2026-019)
167-177 Southwest Cutoff: drive-thru, gas station, retail, and parking changes (ZB-2026-094)
14-18 Kiara Drive: two townhouse buildings with ±11 dwelling units; redraw lot lines (ZB-2026-071)
209 Lincoln Street: convert two-family dwelling into a 5-unit residential structure (ZB-2026-099)
195 Mill Street: seven multi-family dwellings with ±255 units and ±389 parking spaces (ZB-2026-100)
538 Grove Street: retroactive approval for a front porch (ZB-2026-101)
18 Crown Street: four townhouse dwellings with parking (ZB-2026-102)
118 Dana Avenue: divide parcel and build a semi-detached duplex (ZB-2026-103)
Board policies and procedures: board elections and CPTC training opportunities
location: Levi Lincoln Chamber, 3rd Floor (Room 309), Worcester City Hall, 455 Main Street

This Worcester Zoning Board of Appeals meeting will be held in-person at the 
date, time and location listed above. Meeting attendees will additionally have 
options to participate remotely by joining online or by phone below.  
 
• Use the following link to join the meeting via computer: 
https://worcesterma.zoomgov.com/j/1604564634 
 
• Use the following number to call in by phone: 1-669-254-5252 
 
• Access Code: 160 456 4634  
 
• If you join the meeting by phone, you can raise your hand by dialing *9 and 
once called upon, unmute by dialing *6. 
 
Note: If technological problems interrupt the virtual meeting component, the 
meeting will continue in-person. 
 
Application materials may be viewed online at: Zoning Board of Appeals | City of 
Worcester or by appointment at Planning and Regulatory Services, 455 Main St, 
Room 404, between 8:30 a.m. – 5 p.m., Monday through Friday. 
 
For more information concerning this meeting, please contact the 
Planning and Regulatory Services Division by email at 
planning@worcesterma.gov or phone at 508-799-1400 x31440. Please submit 
requests for reasonable accommodation or requests for language interpretation 
2 business days or more in advance of the meeting. Send written comments 
no less than 48 hours before the public meeting.

Old Business – Public Hearings 
1. ROW Adjacent to 692 Millbury Street (ZB-2026-019) 
Special Permit: To allow a conversion from static to digital display for a non-conforming sign (Article IV, Section 
6.L.2.) 
Petitioner: Lamar Advertising Company  
Present Use: Presently on the premises is a non-accessory freestanding billboard with traditional advertising 
panels. 
Zone Designation ML-2.0 (Manufacturing, Limited) and also within the Blackstone River Parkway Sign Overlay 
District 
Petition Purpose: The applicant seeks to convert the south face of the billboard to a digital display . 
Testimony Date: 7/20/2026 & 9/28/2026 Constructive Grant Deadline: 12/1/2026 
2. 167-177 Southwest Cutoff (ZB-2026-094)  
Special Permit: To allow a food service (drive-thru) use in an MG-2.0 zone (Article IV, Section 2, Table 4.1, 
Business Uses #6) 
Special Permit: To allow an automobile refueling station use in an MG-2.0 zone (Article IV, Section 2, Table 4.1, 
Business Uses #17) 
Special Permit: To allow a retail sales use in an MG-2.0 zone (Article IV, Section 2, Table 4.1, Business Uses #26) 
Special Permit: To modify the parking dimensional, layout, and/or landscaping requirements, loading 
requirements, and/or the number of required parking spaces (Article IV, Section 7.A.2.)  
Petitioner: 167 Southwest Cutoff, LLC and Wister Realty Corp. 
Present Use: Presently on the premises at 167 Southwest Cutoff is a ±11,710 SF commercial building with a 
parking area.  Presently on the premises at 177 Southwest Cutoff is a gas station with a fuel canopy, 
a convenience store with a food service/drive-through, and surface parking. 
Zone Designation MG-2.0 (Manufacturing, General) 
Petition Purpose: The applicant seeks to expand the gas station use onto the 167 Southwest Cutoff property, and at 
177 Southwest Cutoff expand the existing building, relocate the existing drive -through window, 
and expand the existing parking area. 
Testimony Date 10/19/2026 Constructive Grant Deadline: 11/10/2026 
 
New Business – Public Hearings 
3. 14-18 Kiara Drive (ZB-2026-071) 
Variance: For relief from the minimum frontage requirements for a single-family attached dwelling in an RL-7 
zone (Article IV, Section 4, Table 4.2) 
Special Permit: To allow a single-family attached use in the RL-7 zone. (Article IV, Section 4, Table 4.1, Residential 
Use #12) 
Petitioner: CLEB, LLC 
Present Use: Presently on the premises are three vacant partially wooded lots. 
Zone Designation: RL-7 (Residence, Limited) 
Petition Purpose: The applicant seeks to redraw lot lines and construct two single-family attached (townhouse) 
structures with a total of ±11 dwelling units with associated parking spaces. 
Public Hearing Deadline: 12/24/2026 Constructive Grant Deadline: 1/28/2027
3 
 
 
New Business – Public Hearings 
4. 209 Lincoln Street (ZB-2026-099) 
Variance: For relief from the minimum parking requirements for an other residential permitted use in the 
RG-5 zone (Article IV, Section 7, Table 4.4) 
Special Permit: To allow a residential conversion from a two-family dwelling to an other residential permitted use 
in the RG-5 zone (Article IV, Section 9) 
Special Permit: To modify the parking dimensional, layout, and/or landscaping requirements, loading 
requirements, and/or the number of required parking spaces (Article IV, Section 7.A.2.)  
Petitioner: Rafael Hernandez  
Present Use: Presently on the premises is a two-family dwelling and detached garage. 
Zone Designation: RG-5 (Residence, General) 
Petition Purpose: The applicant seeks to convert the existing two-family dwelling into a 5-unit residential structure 
with associated parking and site improvements. 
Public Hearing Deadline: 12/24/2026 Constructive Grant Deadline: 1/28/2027 
5. 195 Mill Street (ZB-2026-100)  
Variance: For relief from the minimum parking requirements for a multi-family dwelling use in the BG-2.0 
zone. (Article IV, Section 7, Table 4.4) 
Special Permit: To modify the parking dimensional, layout, and/or landscaping requirements, loading 
requirements, and/or the number of required parking spaces (Article IV, Section 7.A.2. ) 
Petitioner: Worcester Mill, LLC. 
Present Use: Presently on the premises is a concrete slab from the razed former structure, abandoned surface 
parking pavement, and wooded areas. 
Zone Designation BG-2.0 (Business, General) zoning district and partially in the Floodplain Overlay District  
Petition Purpose: The applicant seeks to construct 7 multi-family dwellings with a total of ±255 units, ±389 
parking spaces, and associated site improvements. 
Public Hearing Deadline: 1/03/2027 Constructive Grant Deadline: 2/07/2027 
6. 538 Grove Street (ZB-2026-101) 
Variance: For relief from the minimum front yard setback requirements for a single- family dwelling in an 
RS-7 zone (Article IV, Section 4, Table 4.2) 
Petitioner: Gissel Kilson  
Present Use: Presently on the premises is a single-family dwelling. 
Zone Designation: RS-7 (Residence, Single Family)  
Petition Purpose: The applicant seeks retroactive approval for the construction of a front porch . 
Public Hearing Deadline: 12/20/2026 Constructive Grant Deadline: 1/24/2027 
7. 18 Crown Street (ZB-2026-102)  
Special Permit To modify the parking dimensional, layout, and/or landscaping requirements, loading 
requirements, and/or the number of required parking spaces (Article IV, Section 7.A.2.)  
Petitioner: 39 Worcester, LLC  
Present Use: Presently on the premises is a vacant lot. 
Zone Designation: RG-5 (Residence, General) zoning district and within the Crown Hill Local Historic District  
Petition Purpose: The applicant seeks to construct four single-family attached (townhouse) dwellings with parking 
and associated site improvements. 
Public Hearing Deadline: 12/23/2026 Constructive Grant Deadline: TBD
4 
 
 
New Business - Public Hearings 
8. 118 Dana Avenue (ZB-2026-103)  
Proposed Lot 1L:   
Variance: For relief from the minimum lot area requirements for a single-family semi-detached dwelling in 
an RG-5 zone (Article IV, Section 4, Table 4.2) 
Variance: For relief from the minimum frontage requirements for a single-family semi-detached dwelling in 
an RG-5 zone (Article IV, Section 4, Table 4.2) 
Variance: For relief from the minimum side yard setback requirements for a single-family semi-detached 
dwelling in an RG-5 zone (Article IV, Section 4, Table 4.2 
Proposed Lot 1R:  
Variance: For relief from the minimum lot area requirements for a single-family semi-detached dwelling in 
an RG-5 zone (Article IV, Section 4, Table 4.2) 
Variance: For relief from the minimum frontage requirements for a single-family semi-detached dwelling in 
an RG-5 zone (Article IV, Section 4, Table 4.2) 
Variance: For relief from the minimum side yard setback requirements for a single-family semi-detached 
dwelling in an RG-5 zone (Article IV, Section 4, Table 4.2) 
Petitioner: D’Angelo and Erika Fernandez  
Present Use: Presently on the premises is a single-family dwelling. 
Zone Designation: RG-5 (Residence, General)  
Petition Purpose: The applicants seek to divide the parcel and construct a single-family semi-detached (duplex) 
dwelling on the newly created lots. 
Public Hearing Deadline: 12/23/2026 Constructive Grant Deadline: 1/27/2027 
 
Other Business 
9. Communications 
10. Discussion of Board Policies and Procedures  
 a. Board Elections 
 b. CPTC Training Opportunities 
10. Approval of Minutes –7/20/2026; 8/10/2026; 8/31/2026; 9/28/2026; 10/19/2026 
11. Adjournment
